ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels covering approximately 92-95% of the visible surface, with high-intensity (white) clusters localized at the distal tips and scattered micro-specks.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous low-intensity dark field across the primary fluke body; high-intensity rosette clusters at the terminal left and right tips; distinct vertical high-intensity linear streaks located mid-left near the notch and mid-right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive peripheral barnacle colonization on both distal tips; irregular trailing edge geometry suggesting historical minor abrasive trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly unique hook-shaped high-contrast pigmentation mark positioned in the upper-quadrant of the right lobe surface.
